articles.title: Taapsee Pannu Says Bollywood Still Won't Invest in Women-Led Action Films
articles.excerpt: Ahead of her Netflix action-drama Gandhari, the actress calls out Bollywood's persistent budget gap between male-led and female-led films, saying expensive technology needed for high-end action remains out of reach for women-fronted projects.
articles.nri_angle: Taapsee Pannu's critique of Bollywood's investment gap resonates with diaspora audiences who follow Hindi cinema and increasingly expect gender parity in storytelling and production values.

articles.title: Hrehaan Roshan, Hrithik's Son, Makes Music Debut With Indie Single From Berklee
articles.excerpt: The 20-year-old Berklee scholar releases 'This Heavenly Place,' an acoustic English-language track that marks the first independent music career from the Roshan family
articles.image_caption: Hrithik Roshan at an event. His son Hrehaan Roshan has released his debut indie single from Berklee College of Music.

articles.title: Meghna Gulzar Says Daayra Reveals an 'Entirely Unseen' Kareena Kapoor Khan
articles.excerpt: Director praises Kareena's stoic, unreadable performance as crime thriller's trailer approaches August 31 launch
articles.image_caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan, who stars as ACP Ajooni Kohli in Meghna Gulzar's upcoming crime thriller Daayra, releasing September 18.
articles.nri_angle: Cross-industry Hindi-Malayalam collaboration reflects Bollywood's evolving content-driven cinema trend for diaspora audiences

articles.title: Toxic Opens to Rs 140 Crore Worldwide, But Day 2 Drop Raises Questions for Yash
articles.excerpt: Yash's post-KGF gamble delivered a massive Rs 101 crore net on day one in India, yet a steep 64% second-day decline puts pressure on the weekend to determine Toxic's commercial fate.
articles.nri_angle: Yash's crossover from Kannada cinema to pan-India stardom reflects the growing global appetite for South Indian filmmaking among diaspora audiences.

articles.title: Anjali Patil's Tamil Film 'Selvi' to World Premiere at Busan Film Festival
articles.excerpt: The National Award-winning actress's debut production under Anahat Films will screen in Busan's Vision – Asia section in October, marking the banner's first Tamil feature.
articles.image_caption: Indian actress Anjali Patil, whose Tamil film Selvi will have its world premiere at the Busan International Film Festival.
articles.nri_angle: Indian cinema's growing global footprint at premier international film festivals, with an Indian actress-producer championing independent Tamil cinema on world stages.

articles.title: Rukmini Vasanth Faces Backlash Over Intimate Scene in Yash's Toxic, Sparking Cultural Debate
articles.excerpt: A viral scene from Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups has divided audiences, with fans criticizing the Kantara actress's bold portrayal while others defend the film's creative choices.
articles.image_caption: Rukmini Vasanth at the Toxic trailer launch event. The actress is facing online backlash over an intimate scene in the Yash-starrer released on August 26.
articles.nri_angle: The debate around Toxic highlights evolving attitudes toward intimacy in Indian cinema, a topic that resonates strongly with diaspora audiences navigating cultural expectations.

articles.title: Dhamaal 4 Wraps Theatrical Run at ₹160 Crore in India, Declared a Clean Hit
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's comedy franchise closer finishes as Bollywood's fourth hit of 2026, crossing ₹224 crore worldwide and cementing its place as the actor's sixth-highest-grossing film ever.
articles.image_caption: Ajay Devgn, lead star of Dhamaal 4, which closed its Indian theatrical run at approximately ₹160.50 crore nett with a Clean Hit verdict.
articles.nri_angle: Dhamaal 4's overseas collection of ₹29.61 crore reflects strong engagement from NRI audiences who have followed the comedy franchise across its nearly two-decade run.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Obsession Crosses $500 Million Worldwide, Enters All-Time Top 5 Horror Films
articles.excerpt: Curry Barker's micro-budget horror sensation surpasses The Conjuring: Last Rites to become the fifth-highest-grossing horror film in history, delivering a staggering 670x return on its $750,000 budget.
articles.image_caption: Obsession, directed by Curry Barker, has crossed $500 million worldwide, entering the all-time top five horror films at the global box office.
articles.nri_angle: Obsession's remarkable ₹99.25 crore run in India underscores the growing appetite among Indian audiences for original Hollywood horror content beyond franchise fare.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hanuman Ansh Declared a Box Office Success After Miraculous Third-Week Surge
articles.excerpt: The devotional drama collected approximately 8 crore rupees in 19 days after a massive word-of-mouth turnaround, with third-week earnings exceeding its first two weeks combined.
articles.nri_angle: The film’s success mirrors the growing appetite for devotional and mythological content among Indian audiences worldwide, following the blockbuster HanuMan (2024).
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: First-Day Viewers Slam Yash's 'Toxic' for Messy Screenplay Despite Record Advance Sales
articles.excerpt: Yash's long-awaited return to theatres draws sharp criticism for writing and pacing, though his screen presence and the film's visuals earn scattered praise.
articles.image_caption: Kannada superstar Yash at a public event. His highly anticipated film Toxic opened to polarized reviews, with first-day viewers criticizing its screenplay despite record advance ticket sales.
articles.nri_angle: Yash's Toxic recorded strong overseas pre-sales, including more than 400 screens in the UK, reflecting the Kannada star's pan-India and NRI following.

articles.title: 7 Dogs Review: Saudi Arabia's $40 Million Action Spectacle Brings Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt Into a Globe-Trotting Thriller
articles.excerpt: The Saudi-backed action film features a sprawling international cast including Monica Bellucci and Giancarlo Esposito, but critics say spectacle wins over story.
articles.image_caption: Bollywood actor Salman Khan. His latest film 7 Dogs, a Saudi Arabia-backed action spectacle, has generated significant buzz.

articles.title: Suriya's Vishwanath And Sons Enters Rs 100 Crore Club as Telugu States Outpace Tamil Nadu
articles.excerpt: The family entertainer crossed Rs 100 crore at the Indian box office in 10 days, with Telugu states contributing more than the film's home market — a rare reversal for a Tamil original.
articles.image_caption: Tamil actor Suriya. His latest film Vishwanath And Sons has crossed Rs 100 crore at the box office, with Telugu states contributing the bulk of collections.
articles.nri_angle: Suriya has a dedicated NRI fanbase in the US and Gulf, where Vishwanath And Sons opened to strong advance bookings.

articles.title: Lokesh Kanagaraj's DC Crosses Rs 100 Crore Worldwide in Debut Acting Milestone
articles.excerpt: The Tamil filmmaker's first acting role hits Rs 100 crore globally in two weeks, making Wamiqa Gabbi a rare star with two century-grossers in a single year.
articles.image_caption: Tamil filmmaker Lokesh Kanagaraj. His debut acting venture DC has crossed Rs 100 crore at the worldwide box office.
articles.nri_angle: DC has drawn NRI audiences in North America and the Gulf, where Tamil cinema has a strong theatrical footprint.

articles.title: Govinda Warns of Rs 100 Crore Legal Action Over False Marriage and Divorce Claims
articles.excerpt: The veteran Bollywood actor issues a public notice targeting media outlets and content creators days after wife Sunita Ahuja withdrew her divorce petition.
articles.image_caption: Bollywood actor Govinda and wife Sunita Ahuja at a public event. The actor has issued a public notice threatening Rs 100 crore in damages over false claims about his marriage.
articles.nri_angle: Govinda remains a beloved figure among the Indian diaspora, and the prolonged marital saga has been widely followed by NRI audiences on social media.

articles.title: Regional Cinema Dominates IFFM 2026 as Indian Film Breaks Free of Bollywood's Shadow
articles.excerpt: Kannada, Malayalam, and Assamese films swept major awards at the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne, underscoring how Indian cinema's center of gravity is shifting beyond Hindi.
articles.image_caption: The Indian Film Festival of Melbourne, Australia's largest celebration of Indian cinema.
articles.nri_angle: IFFM, held in Melbourne with state government backing, is the largest celebration of Indian cinema outside India and serves as a cultural bridge for the Australian-Indian diaspora, showcasing stories in languages that reflect their diverse regional roots.

articles.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas Premieres 'The Cycle of Love' Documentary in New York
articles.excerpt: The Oscar-winning documentary tells the true story of P.K. Mahanandia, a Dalit street artist from Delhi who cycled 6,000 miles to Sweden in the 1970s to reunite with the woman he loved.
articles.image_caption: Priyanka Chopra Jonas at a recent public appearance promoting The Cycle of Love. The actress executive produced the documentary about an Indian street artist who cycled 6,000 miles to Sweden for love.
articles.nri_angle: The film resonates deeply with the Indian diaspora experience — a cross-cultural love story spanning continents, produced by India's biggest global star, exploring themes of identity and belonging.

articles.title: Aamir Khan Begins Major Weight-Loss Transformation to Play a 25-Year-Old in Lalkaara
articles.excerpt: The actor reunites with Lagaan director Ashutosh Gowariker for a sports drama set against the backdrop of Indian cricket and Partition, requiring him to shed significant weight.
articles.image_caption: Aamir Khan at a recent public appearance in Mumbai. The actor has begun an intensive weight-loss program for his upcoming sports drama Lalkaara, directed by Ashutosh Gowariker.
articles.nri_angle: The Lagaan reunion and cricket-Partition narrative taps into a story deeply familiar to the Indian diaspora, many of whose families carry Partition memories.

articles.title: Nayanthara and South Indian Stars Bring the Kasavu Saree Back Into the Spotlight for Onam 2026
articles.excerpt: As Kerala's biggest harvest festival peaks with Thiruvonam on August 26, the 'Lady Superstar' and fellow actresses are setting festive fashion benchmarks in the traditional white-and-gold drape.
articles.image_caption: Nayanthara poses in a traditional saree, showcasing the minimalist elegance that has made her a style reference for South Indian festivals. The actress is set for an Onam season release with her film Gold alongside Prithviraj Sukumaran.
articles.nri_angle: Kasavu sarees are a staple at diaspora Onam gatherings worldwide, connecting NRI Malayalis to Kerala's cultural identity through fashion.
